messages.content: I’ll set a day-ahead arbitrage book, then monitor each watch and adjust the unfrozen hours as new information arrives.
The day-ahead book is committed and passed all feasibility checks. It projects $82,756.53 in net profit at DA prices and a 75 MWh ending charge. No new information at midnight warrants a change.
The battery is full at 150 MWh. I’m retaining the 75 MW discharges at 19:00 and 20:00, followed by late-night charging to restore the required 75 MWh.
